name: Ladner Elementary Modular Addition

heroImage.alt: NSC excavator beside an open trench with new water service pipe at Ladner Elementary

lede: Demolition, utilities and paving to make room for new modular classrooms at Ladner Elementary.
body:
We removed existing site infrastructure and prepared the ground for the modular buildings, then upgraded the storm, sanitary and water services to suit.

The job finished with reinforced concrete sidewalks and slabs, and new paving across the parking area and school yard.
scope: Demolition and removal of existing site infrastructure
Site preparation for modular building installation
Storm and sanitary sewer system upgrade
Asphalt overlay and new paving at the parking area and school yard

gallery.alt: Excavated strip footing trench for the modular classrooms
Excavated modular pad with geotextile and granular base
Completed modular classroom pad and surrounding site works
